purpose: separate selected-trade false positives from actual within-day candidate ranking efficiency
population: all 1,821 persisted final candidate events across the three independent authoritative blocks
hypothetical_entry: next authoritative market-session open only when the symbol row is present, hard_valid=true, current_day_data_tradable=true, buy_blocked_open=false, and open is finite and positive

fixed_horizon_path.coordinate: corporate-action-adjusted total return from hypothetical next-session open
fixed_horizon_path.mfe: maximum daily high through the horizon, including the entry session after its open
fixed_horizon_path.terminal: close on the final horizon session
fixed_horizon_path.coverage: missing unless every intervening symbol-session row and corporate action is valid; no imputation

selected_definition: authoritative filled new-position BUY whose signal date and symbol match the final candidate event; terminal-open cycles are retained because fixed-horizon outcomes do not require completed V1 exits
primary_comparisons: selected versus unselected MFE20/opportunity20/opportunity50/close20 within candidate-positive signal days
within-day de-meaned opportunity quality of selected candidates
candidate-day best MFE20 captured by any selected member
frozen RS score relation with MFE20 by year and LOYO
candidate count versus same-day mean/best/dispersion of MFE20 after breadth and year
oracle_warning: unselected outcomes use hypothetical fills and fixed horizons, not authoritative V1 exits; best-candidate capture and regret are hindsight oracles and cannot form a strategy or NAV
